jobs.title: Senior Principal Product Manager - Data Refinery
jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.


At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.


**Your Team's Impact**

  

We are seeking a Senior Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of the Catalog and Governance capabilities within the FactSet Intelligence Platform (FIP) Data Layer.  



  

This role owns the catalog as the authoritative system connecting semantic models, and physical data sets, enabling trusted, secure, and discoverable data across domains. The Senior Principal Product Manager will implement governance frameworks, model standards, and catalog services that support scalable domain onboarding, data model compliance, and AI\-ready data access. As a senior leader, this role also drives insights\-based product discovery and cross\-functional strategy alignment.  



  

**What You'll Do**

Insights — Derives insights to support product bets


* Understands the dynamics of domain teams, governance \& standards office, platform consumers, and stakeholders relying on catalog and governance capabilities; builds this understanding through regular and direct engagement.
* Owns product discovery for catalog and governance capabilities — proactively validates opportunities (e.g., model standards, lineage tooling, compliance frameworks) to prove value, viability, feasibility, and usability before development.
* Uses catalog adoption, model quality, and governance compliance data to evaluate and inform strategy and decision\-making.
* Measures what matters: discoverability, trust, and access enablement, alongside adoption, engagement, and compliance metrics.

Strategy — Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results


* Defines and executes the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for Catalog \& Governance in the context of the FIP Data Layer and overall platform strategy.
* Evangelizes catalog and governance strategy across domain and platform teams.
* Owns business case development for governance tooling and catalog investment (resourcing, KPIs).
* Accountable for adoption, compliance, and domain onboarding goals.
* Partners with the Governance office and domain teams to operationalize governance requirements and best practices.
* Creates a product roadmap that aligns Data Platform, Semantics, Security, Architecture, and Domain teams, sharing timelines, constraints, and dependencies.

Execution — Delivers on product outcomes


* Establishes the catalog as the system of record for model, domain definitions, and physical data assets.
* Defines logical\-to\-physical data mappings to enable semantic discovery and governed data access.
* Ensures model quality, completeness, lineage, and lifecycle management standards.
* Delivers governance tooling, policies, and measurement frameworks that enable compliance at scale.
* Implements standards for data classification, privacy, security, access controls, and auditability based on the Governance Framework.
* Enables seamless resolution from business concepts and user intent to governed data assets.
* Partners with development teams to define acceptance criteria and deliver usable, well\-governed products.
* As a subject matter expert in catalog and governance, serves as a resource for complex support escalations and advocates for reducing support burden.

Leadership — Inspires cross\-functional teams to achieve great outcomes


* Influences and motivates Data Platform, Semantics, Security, Architecture, Governance \& Standards office and Domain teams, without authority, to achieve catalog and governance outcomes.
* Drives adoption of governance and catalog best practices across the department.
* Coordinates delivery across multiple domain and cross platform teams.

**What We're Looking For**

Required Skills


* 15\+ years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in data platforms, governance, metadata, or analytics ecosystems.
* Experience with data catalogs, data model management, data governance, and enterprise data architecture.
* Strong understanding of logical data modeling, data lineage, and mapping business concepts to physical data assets.
* Proven success delivering platform products across multiple teams and stakeholders at scale, including influencing without direct authority.

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:


* The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up.
* Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company\-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in product research in an applied research setting, or similar.
* Experience in programming languages used for data manipulation and computational statistics (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, C\+\+, Java, or Go).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Human\-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or related field.
* 3 years of experience working with executive leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
* 2 years of experience conducting UX research on products, managing projects, and working in a large, matrixed organization.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a Quantitative User Experience Researcher (Quant UXR), you make this possible. You will join a multi\-disciplinary team, collaborating closely with Engineering and Product Management to create industry\-leading, innovative products.  

  

You will drive impact at all stages of development by investigating user behavior through empirical methods like logs analysis, survey research, and regression. We value the educational experiences—from Computer Science to Psychology—and require a blend of behavioral research design, statistical proficiency, and programming skills to uncover actionable insights. Beyond the work, you will grow within a supportive Quant UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools to help you thrive.


Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and measure quantitative UX goals and metrics in collaboration with designers, qualitative researchers, data scientists, engineers and program managers.
* Develop code and statistical models to understand user experience.
* Conduct empirical research using methods from computer science, quantitative social science, statistics, econometrics, and other fields to understand user behavior and extract meaningful patterns from large data sets.
* Examine existing data and product designs to generate hypotheses and plans for high\-impact research.
* Prioritize and drive research to improve user experience. Communicate findings to stakeholders in the company. Make research findings convincing and actionable for both research experts and non\-experts.

Are you excited about empowering millions of developers and AI/ML builders across enterprises and digital natives with the best experience to build, test, and scale their applications with AI? Do you love turning data into insight, and insight into product decisions that shape how developers code every day?


The GitHub Copilot Science team under CoreAI at Microsoft India Development Center (IDC) is looking for a data\-driven product manager to help define, measure, and ship AI\-powered coding experiences for developers. Our division's mission is to empower builders and their teams to achieve more.


We are a fast\-paced, experimentation\-first team. We love to push the boundaries of what is possible with AI\-assisted development. If this sounds like the kind of environment where you will grow and have fun, please join us!

 **Responsibilities**  

In this role you will:

* Partner closely with data science, applied science, and engineering to own the data, models, agentic harness and measurement strategy for Copilot / VS Code experiences and connect them to real online outcomes.
* Define the online and offline metrics that tell us whether a feature is working and moving developer productivity.

* Analyze competition and market trends across AI coding assistants to build a coherent strategy for growing adoption and engagement.
* Define success metrics, communicate them clearly, measure them, and use them to iteratively improve the services.

Traits we look for in product managers:

* Relentless customer obsession paired with rigorous attention to data quality and detail.
* Comfort living in the data \- you reach for a query or a notebook before an opinion.
* Active listening to understand (Growth mindset).
* Clarity in communication without ambiguity across all formats. Break down complex ideas and explain them simply with data.
 **Qualifications*** 6\+ years of product management experience shipping enterprise or consumer products in the software industry. Experience building large\-scale AI/ML products/services is preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in data analysis and experimentation \- designing and interpreting A/B flights, defining online and offline metrics, and driving decisions from telemetry.
* Hands\-on comfort with data tools (notebooks, and dashboards such as Kusto/ADX, Power BI, or similar) to independently explore data and validate hypotheses.

* Strong analytical skills and an aptitude for solving complex business problems.

jobs.title: Product Manager — AI Products
jobs.description:
BuzzBoard
   

  

* Remote (WFH)
* Product


**About BuzzBoard**
 BuzzBoard builds AI products for the B2SMB market — helping agencies, media companies, and sellers understand small businesses and market to them at a level of personalization that wasn't previously economical.
   

  

 Our platform is built on frontier models end to end. Not AI features bolted onto a legacy product — the products
 *are* 
 agent systems.
   

  

 Our products span multi\-agent marketing content generation, real\-time AI voice intake, and pre\- and post\-sales intelligence for SMBs — Zylo, IRIS, Ignite, and Ember. They share a common internal pipeline for orchestration, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and deployment, and a spec\-driven development process that treats agent behavior as a first\-class design artifact.
   

  

**The role**
 This is a Product Manager role for people who build, not just specify.
   

  

 Two things are equally true about how we work, and both are non\-negotiable expectations of this role:
   

  

* The products you own are agent systems, and they are non\-deterministic. Your design surface is prompts, tool definitions, retrieval strategy, schema contracts, model selection, fallback behavior, and failure modes. “The model got it wrong” is a product bug you are expected to diagnose and specify a fix for — not escalate
* You use these models to do the product work. You will write specs, generate structured data, produce working HTML prototypes, run evaluation batches, and analyze output quality using the same models the products run on. Our specs ship as machine\-readable handoff sets, and prototypes ship with live model stubs. If your definition of a spec is a Confluence page of prose, this role will be uncomfortable


**What You'll Actually Do**
* Own one or more product lines — outcomes, roadmap, sequencing, and the quality bar
* Write the spec set engineering builds from: product spec, engineering spec, model spec, and handoff readiness — decisions resolved, not deferred
* Design the agent behavior — prompt architecture, output schemas, deterministic vs. model\-decided logic, guardrails, and what happens when the model is wrong or the tool call fails
* Build prototypes yourself — working HTML with live model calls, ahead of engineering commitment, so we argue about a thing instead of a document
* Define and run evaluations — build eval sets, score output batches, set ship/no\-ship thresholds, and drive prompt and model iteration off measured results rather than vibes
* Make the model tradeoffs — model choice, context strategy, latency, token cost per unit of output, fine\-tune vs. prompt vs. retrieval
* Work directly with engineering, GenAI, and design on daily execution; hold the line on schema and interface contracts between agents
* Interface with customers and enterprise partners, including US\-based partners with real security, privacy, and compliance review processes
* Instrument and read the data — usage, quality, cost, and drift — and act on it


**What we're looking for**
**Required**
* 4\+ years in product management, ideally B2B SaaS
* Demonstrated hands\-on work with LLM / agent products: prompt design, structured output, retrieval, tool/function calling, evaluation. We will ask you to walk through something you shipped in detail
* Fluency using AI tooling in your own workflow — specs, prototypes, analysis, code reading
* Ability to read code and API contracts well enough to review a schema, follow a pipeline, and spot a bad interface
* Track record of shipping — features live, in customers' hands, with measured outcomes
* Strong written communication; you can take a technical decision and make it legible to a CEO and to an engineer in the same document
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and short cycles


**Preferred**
* Degree in AI/ML, Engineering, CS, or a related technical field
* Direct experience with OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic/Claude, LangChain, or equivalent orchestration stacks
* Experience with voice AI, agentic workflows, or multi\-agent systems
* Experience with fine\-tuning, dataset curation, or model performance analysis
* Experience working with US customers and enterprise partners
* SMB or marketing\-technology domain knowledge


**What this role is not**
* Not a backlog\-grooming or ticket\-triage role
* Not a role where AI strategy is delegated to a data science team you email
* Not a role where a spec can end with “TBD, engineering to decide”


**What we offer**
* Fully remote
* Genuine ownership of a product line, with the latitude to shape it
* Work at the current frontier of applied AI product development — agent systems, evals, voice, and multi\-model orchestration in production
* A small, high\-context team that moves quickly and argues about the work
* Real impact on the small businesses our customers serve

 if you're a product manager who builds with these models daily and wants to own products made of them.

You will lead the product lifecycle from discovery to launch and continuous improvement, balancing performance, cost, security, and compliance. jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript).
* 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
* 5 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
* 2 years of experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, multi\-modal, large vision models) or with GenAI\-related concepts (e.g., language modeling, computer vision).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of approximately 6\-10 software engineers responsible for delivering an exceptional client experience for Looker. Your role is to build a team and guide them to execute on cloud data analytics priorities. You will hire, develop, and retain a team of software engineers. You will be responsible for their career growth, providing coaching, and managing performance to build an exceptional engineering organization. You will ensure the team's roadmap directly supports the critical goal of differentiated BI experiences using AI. You will collaborate closely with Product Management, other Cloud Data engineering teams, and customer\-facing roles to respond to customer needs, and influence product direction.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Cultivate a team environment that is psychologically safe and encourages collaboration and innovation. Empower your team to take ownership and deliver outstanding results. Partner with Product Management and technical leads to define and execute the technical strategy for Looker.
* Guide the team through complex architectural decisions and ensure high standards for code quality are maintained through effective design and code review processes. Improve the end\-to\-end customer experience, from ease of use to debuggability and raw performance. Help customers profile their workload, and tune it for GCP.
* Ensure the team delivers high\-quality software on time. Set priorities, manage the project execution, and communicate progress and risks to stakeholders across the organization.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

**Description**


Senior Cybersecurity Engineer – Exposure Management
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Core Responsibilities**

* **CTEM Program Maturity \& Operating Model**
* Help define, implement, and continuously improve the CTEM lifecycle across scoping, discovery, prioritization, validation, and mobilization.
* Translate exposure management strategy into repeatable operating processes, decision criteria, governance routines, and measurable outcomes.
* Identify maturity gaps across asset coverage, signal quality, prioritization, validation, remediation ownership, exception handling, and executive reporting.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, identity, application, architecture, and business teams to establish shared accountability for exposure reduction.
* Drive structured exposure review cycles that move the organization from vulnerability reporting to validated, risk\-based remediation and measurable risk reduction.
* **Exposure Management Engineering**
* Engineer and operate exposure management capabilities across infrastructure, cloud, endpoints, identity, applications, and third\-party surfaces.
* Maintain and enhance tooling that aggregates vulnerability data, asset context, threat intelligence, and exploitability signals.
* Ensure accurate asset discovery, coverage validation, and telemetry quality across the enterprise attack surface.
* **Risk\-Based Prioritization**
* Drive risk\- and threat\-informed prioritization beyond CVSS scoring.
* Incorporate exploit intelligence, threat actor activity, asset criticality, and compensating controls.
* Partner with technology and business owners to translate exposure into remediation priorities.
* **Threat\-Aligned Analysis**
* Correlate exposure data with threat intelligence and adversary TTPs.
* Support zero\-day and emerging threat response through rapid exposure analysis.
* **Metrics, Reporting \& Insight**
* Define and maintain CTEM outcome metrics, including exposure reduction, risk burndown, validated closure rate, SLA adherence, exception aging, reintroduced exposure rate, coverage gaps, telemetry freshness, owner assignment accuracy, and remediation cycle time.
* Build executive, operational, engineering, and audit views that clearly explain risk, accountability, trend, residual exposure, and progress against maturity goals.
* Convert technical findings into business\-relevant narratives that support prioritization, funding, architecture decisions, and remediation mobilization.
* Identify recurring exposure patterns and recommend control, architecture, automation, or process improvements.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Mobilization**
* Lead exposure reduction initiatives across teams without direct reporting authority, using data, risk rationale, business impact, and clear decision records to drive alignment.
* Facilitate remediation planning across infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, application, identity, SOC, GRC, and business stakeholders.
* Build consensus on ownership, prioritization, compensating controls, exception paths, and remediation timelines.
* Escalate systemic blockers with clear options, residual risk framing, and recommended decisions.
* Mentor analysts and engineers while raising the overall maturity of exposure management practices.
* **Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of cybersecurity experience, including significant hands\-on experience in vulnerability management, exposure management, threat\-informed defense, cloud security, infrastructure security, or security operations engineering.
* Demonstrated experience operating or maturing a risk\-based vulnerability management, exposure management, or CTEM\-aligned program.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional remediation initiatives without direct reporting authority.
* Strong understanding of CTEM lifecycle concepts: scoping, discovery, prioritization, validation, and mobilization.
* Experience correlating asset context, exploitability, threat intelligence, business criticality, control state, and remediation feasibility into defensible prioritization decisions.

**Lead Site Reliability Engineer**  



**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!


**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer, you will take on strategic and technical ownership within a Product Area, providing leadership across cloud infrastructure, service reliability, and platform operations. This role is ideal for a highly experienced engineer ready to guide others, shape our operational standards, and ensure SimCorp’s cloud platform delivers excellence to both newly onboarded and long\-standing clients.


You’ll lead reliability\-focused design sessions, drive the adoption of SRE principles, and champion automation and observability improvements. In addition, you will coach and mentor team members to grow technical capability across the Product Area while contributing to platform\-wide initiatives.


**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Azure\-hosted environments
* Lead operational support and onboarding activities for new and running client platforms
* Provide technical leadership in SRE practices, tooling, and incident response
* Guide the transition of manual processes into automated, scalable solutions
* Lead solutions workshops, engage with vendors, and manage senior stakeholders
* Implement and evolve observability frameworks using SLOs, SLIs, and proactive alerting
* Oversee disaster recovery planning, incident postmortems, and root cause analysis
* Ensure high\-quality onboarding delivery through reusable automation pipelines
* Mentor and support the growth of junior and senior engineers in your Product Area
* Collaborate with product owners and architects to influence platform design and future roadmaps
* Provide weekend or on\-call support as needed

**WHAT WE VALUE**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 5–8\+ years in Site Reliability Engineering or Cloud Infrastructure leadership roles
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, including production\-grade design and operation
* Proficiency with IaC tools like Terraform, Bicep, ARM, Ansible

* Experience in leading incident response and platform\-wide reliability improvements

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.


**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually **. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


For any questions you are welcome to contact **Swati Pal (Swati.pal@simcorp.com)** , Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.


We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.


**WHO WE ARE?**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.

TECH \& EXPERIENCE · PLATFORMS \& INTERACTIVE

**Sr. Developer — Tech \& Experience**

*Own the platforms end to end.*

**HEAD OFFICE — HYDERABAD, INDIA**

The platforms Phoenix runs on — the site, the event microsites and registration, Phoenix Pulse, the interactive layer on the floor, and the internal tooling — need one person who owns them running clean. Someone who keeps the code sound, the systems up and the roadmap honest. That ownership is this role.

As a Senior Tech \& Experience Developer at Phoenix Live, you own the technology estate end to end — architecture and build, reliability and performance, the experience layer that reaches audiences, and the AI\-native tooling the company is building on — and you guide the developers who build it with you. You make technology a source of certainty the whole company leans on.

This is where the platforms get owned, end to end.

**THE COMPANY, IN FULL**

Who we are, the brands we build for, and how we take a show end\-to\-end — **see it at phoenixlive.in**

**01 WHAT YOU’LL OWN**

**Own the platforms**

— Own architecture, build and quality across the site, microsites and registration.

— Own Phoenix Pulse and the internal tooling the company depends on.

— Set the standards for code, review, testing and documentation.

**Own reliability**

— Own uptime, performance and security across everything you ship.

— Own the show\-day readiness of every platform an audience or client touches.

— Build so failure is planned for — if it can fail, it has a backup.

**Own the experience layer**

— Own the interactive and on\-floor technology that reaches audiences.

— Partner with creative and production so the tech serves the show.

— Bring AI\-native capability into the work where it genuinely earns its place.

**Lead and grow**

— Guide and develop the developers into precise, reliable owners.

— Own the roadmap and be honest about what it costs and what it returns.

— Build toward leading a technology team as the function grows.

**02 WHAT’S IN YOUR KIT**

**What you’ll bring**

— A proven record of owning platforms in production, not just features.

— Command of architecture, build, reliability and performance.

— The judgement to choose boring, durable solutions when they are right.

— Calm ownership when something breaks close to a show date.

**Software \& tools**

***Command across the toolkit***

— Full\-stack web development and platform architecture.

— APIs, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure.

— Reliability, performance, security and deployment ownership.

*Strong to have*

— Interactive, real\-time or on\-floor experience technology.

— AI\-native tooling, automation and internal platform building.

*What sets you apart*

— A platform you owned in production and kept standing.

— Developers you made better.

**Experience —** 6 – 8 years building and owning web platforms, product surfaces or interactive experience technology — with systems you owned in production.

**Education \& credentials —** A background in computer science, engineering or a related field is preferred; a record of owning platforms that stayed up matters most.

**03 WHERE THIS ROLE SITS**

You sit at the heart of Tech \& Experience — owning the platforms, guiding the Developers, and working with Marketing, Creative and Operations on what gets built next. It’s the level where you both build cleanly yourself and start building the people who will.

**What good looks like**

— The platforms are sound, fast and up — especially on show days.

— What gets built matches what was promised, and it holds at scale.

— The roadmap is honest and leadership can plan against it.

— The developers you guide become reliable owners.

**04 WHO THIS ROLE ISN’T FOR**

— Someone who can own a feature but not a platform in production.

— A builder who won’t own reliability, security or the fixes.

— Anyone who chases new tools over what actually holds up.

— A soloist who won’t grow the developers around them.

jobs.description:
**Vær med til at forme fremtidens digitale platform til nogle af Danmarks største** 
**retailvirksomheder.**
 Hos Brandhouse hjælper vi hver dag nogle af Danmarks stærkeste retailbrands med at håndtere komplekse marketing\- og produktflows. Det gør vi gennem Publicator – vores egen digitale platform, som gennem mere end 20 år er blevet udviklet i tæt samarbejde med vores kunder.
   

  

 Nu står vi overfor næste store udvikling.
   

  

 AI, automatisering og nye digitale arbejdsgange ændrer den måde, vores kunder arbejder på. Det stiller nye krav til Publicator – og åbner samtidig op for nye muligheder. Derfor søger vi en Digital Product Manager, der har lyst til at være med til at definere produktets næste kapitel.
   

  

 Om rollen \& ansvarsområder
   

  

 Som Digital Product Manager får du ansvaret for at sætte den strategiske retning for Publicator og sikre, at produktet fortsat udvikler sig i takt med vores kunders behov og den teknologiske udvikling.
   

  

 Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med nogle af Danmarks største retailvirksomheder for at forstå deres forretning, arbejdsgange og udfordringer. Med afsæt i den indsigt får du ansvaret for at omsætte kundernes behov til en langsigtet produktstrategi, tydelige udviklingsprioriteter og konkrete initiativer, der skaber størst mulig forretningsværdi for både kunderne og Brandhouse.
   

  

 Samtidig bliver du bindeleddet mellem kunder, forretning og udvikling. Du får ansvaret for at skabe retning i den daglige produktudvikling og sikre, at udviklingsteamet har klare prioriteringer og de bedste forudsætninger for at omsætte strategien til løsninger, der skaber værdi.
   

  

**Du Kommer Blandt Andet Til At**
* Udvikle og drive produktvisionen og roadmappet for Publicator.

* Prioritere og planlægge udviklingen ud fra kundeværdi, kommercielt potentiale og teknisk realiserbarhed.
* Arbejde tæt sammen med kunder, udviklere og ledelsen om produktets videre udvikling.


 Din profil
   

  

 Vi leder efter en person, der motiveres af at udvikle digitale produkter og skabe værdi i krydsfeltet mellem kunder, forretning og teknologi. Du trives med at skabe retning og overblik i komplekse sammenhænge og motiveres af at få forskellige fagligheder til at arbejde mod et fælles mål.
   

  

**Vi Forestiller Os, At Du**
* Har erfaring med digital produktudvikling – gerne som Digital Product Manager, Product Manager eller fra en lignende rolle.
* Har arbejdet med komplekse digitale produkter eller SaaS\-løsninger.
* Har erfaring med at samarbejde tæt med udviklingsteams og omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete udviklingsopgaver.
* Er god til at skabe struktur, prioritere og sikre fremdrift i udviklingsarbejdet.
* Trives med en rolle, hvor du er det daglige bindeled mellem kunder, forretning og udviklere.
* Er en dygtig kommunikator, der kan skabe tillid på tværs af både tekniske og kommercielle profiler.
* Er nysgerrig på AI, digital transformation og udviklingen af digitale produkter.


 Succeskriterier
   

  

 Vi forventer ikke, at du har alle svar fra første dag. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, udfordrer eksisterende løsninger og skaber stærke relationer til både kunder og kolleger.
   

  

**Efter Dit Første År Forventer Vi, At**
* Du har opbygget stærke relationer til vores største kunder og har en dyb forståelse for deres forretning.
* Der er etableret en tydelig produktstrategi og et prioriteret roadmap for Publicator.
* Udviklingsprioriteterne understøtter både kundernes behov og Brandhouses forretningsmål.
* Muligheder inden for AI, integrationer og produktforbedringer er identificeret og omsat til konkrete initiativer.
* Publicator står endnu stærkere som en strategisk platform for både vores kunder og Brandhouse.


 Derfor skal du vælge Brandhouse
   

  

 Hos Brandhouse bliver du en del af et tværfagligt miljø med mere end 65 generalister og specialister inden for strategi, branding, design, marketing, PR, teknologi og produktion.
   

  

 Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger bliver skabt, når forskellige fagligheder arbejder tæt sammen, og når beslutningsvejene er korte.
   

  

 Hos os får du ikke bare ansvar for et produkt. Du får mulighed for at præge udviklingen af en platform, som allerede spiller en vigtig rolle hos nogle af Danmarks største retailvirksomheder – og som har et stort potentiale for den næste fase af sin udvikling.

 Agility: Our Quality solutions stretch from the first seeds of innovation in R\&D through to finished product release in our Quality Control labs. Your agility and communication skills will be key in staying effective against the breadth of solutions we support.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

*

* Experience of supporting complex change and/or multi\-disciplinary projects

* Experience using DevOps and Service Management solutions

 The skills for success
   

  

 Quality solutions Veeva Quality One, LabWare LIMS, Empower CDS and Chromeleon CDS
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality

jobs.title: CMMS Admin
jobs.description:
The Business Systems Analyst (BSA) – Labs Technology supports the configuration, administration, integration and ongoing operations of the Labs technology stack within GWS. Working as part of a broader technology team, this person assists in bridging laboratory operations, client IT teams and CBRE's internal technology stakeholders. A working understanding of IFM technology platforms is essential to this role: the Labs and IFM stacks are related, and this analyst must be able to understand both environments, identify where they intersect and help ensure data and process continuity across the full technology landscape. They support accurate system setups, stable integrations and effective end\-user enablement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**System Configuration and Administration**
 ‒ Support end\-to\-end setup, configuration and launch of Labs technology platforms across new and existing client accounts, especially the tool eMaint.
   

  

 ‒ Assist in managing system hierarchies, asset structures, workflows and scheduling configurations to reflect the operational requirements of laboratory environments.
   

  

 ‒ Support data integrity across Labs platforms, assisting in regular audits and corrective action as needed.
   

  

 ‒ Document system configurations, change logs and administration procedures to support continuity and audit readiness in regulated environments.
   

  

 ‒ Apply working knowledge of IFM technology platforms to understand how Labs systems relate to the broader GWS technology landscape and identify dependencies.
   

  

**Integration and Technical Solutioning**
 ‒ Facilitate quality integrations between CBRE Labs technology tools and client enterprise systems to ensure consistent, reliable data flow.
   

  

 ‒ Identify and manage integration points between the Labs technology stack and IFM platforms, ensuring both environments remain aligned and data flows accurately across them.
   

  

 ‒ Assess integration and feature requirements in partnership with business teams, providing clear technical guidance on configurations at both ends.
   

  

 ‒ Troubleshoot integration failures, data mapping issues and API connectivity problems, escalating appropriately when needed.
   

  

 ‒ Develop and maintain integration documentation, including data dictionaries, flow diagrams and configuration specifications.
   

  

 ‒ Evaluate technology requests from on\-account teams and clients, articulate downstream impacts across both Labs and IFM systems, and propose solutions aligned to platform capabilities.
   

  

**Project Support and Transition Delivery**
 ‒ Support Labs technology implementation projects from initiation through hypercare, assisting with planning, execution, testing, training and sign\-off activities.
   

  

 ‒ Maintain and update transition documents including implementation timelines, risk logs, action trackers and project closure records.
   

  

 ‒ Identify, track and escalate risks and issues in a timely manner, providing mitigation options to transition leadership.
   

  

 ‒ Contribute to project status reporting, providing input on timeline adherence, open issues and escalations for senior leadership review.
   

  

 ‒ Support hypercare sessions with end users post\-go\-live, documenting action items and following through to closure.
   

  

 ‒ Participate in shift rotation requirements as the account and project schedule demands.
   

  

**Training and End\-User Enablement**
 ‒ Assist in documenting system training programs for end users and administrators, both before and after go\-live.
   

  

 ‒ Support the development of training materials including user guides, quick\-reference cards and recorded walkthroughs.
   

  

 ‒ Respond to post\-go\-live support requests, diagnosing issues and providing clear resolution guidance.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management and Communication**
 ‒ Translate complex technical requirements into clear, actionable guidance for system configuration
   

  

 ‒ Contribute to regular status updates for transition leadership, including progress, risks and decisions needed.
   

  

 ‒ Build effective working relationships across CBRE and client teams to support collaborative problem\-solving and timely delivery.
   

  

**Reporting and Analytics**
 ‒ Support the development of standard reporting templates that account teams can use independently.
   

  

 ‒ Analyze system data to identify trends, anomalies and opportunities for platform or process improvement.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To succeed in this role, the individual must demonstrate the following knowledge and skills:
   

  

 ‒ Proven experience administering or implementing enterprise technology platforms preferably in a laboratory, life sciences or scientific operations environment.
   

  

 ‒ Familiarity with IFM technology platforms (such as CMMS, IBM Maximo, Archibus, Planon or similar) and an ability to work across both Labs and IFM technology stacks.
   

  

 ‒ Working knowledge of system integrations, APIs, SSO and data exchange protocols.
   

  

 ‒ Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose technical issues and recommend solutions.
   

  

 ‒ Ability to support project delivery activities, including planning assistance, risk tracking and stakeholder communication.
   

  

 ‒ Ability to read and produce architecture and process flow diagrams.
   

  

 ‒ Application support and infrastructure fundamentals.
   

  

 ‒ Comfortable working across time zones and in shift\-rotation environments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

BlueOptima is a company built on transparency, collaboration, and accountability. We provide organisations with an objective, data\-driven insight into developer efficiency, and how we operate internally is a direct reflection of this.


We are a team made up of tenacious, ambitious, and hungry individuals, who strive to constantly improve and pull together to achieve our ambitious goals. Our company values, and genuine family\-feel working relationships, lead to a working culture of collaboration, learning, autonomy and high performance.

**Our Product**


BlueOptima provides industry\-leading objective metrics in software development using our proprietary Coding Effort Analytics; enabling Fortune 500 organizations to deliver better software, faster and more efficiently.


We currently are located in 5 countries: London (our HQ), Mexico, India, US and Japan. A total number of 110\+ employees (and increasing every day) from different nationalities and with over 25 languages spoken.  



**Location:** Bangalore  

**Department:** Engineering

 **Job Description**  

Code Insights is BlueOptima's application security product — helping engineering and security teams ship secure code faster by catching exposed secrets, static analysis (SAST) vulnerabilities, and risky open\-source dependencies (SCA) before they reach production. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own this product end to end: its roadmap, its narrative, and its commercial outcome.


This is a high\-agency role. You will set the AppSec point of view for Code Insights, defend it under pressure from CISOs and security architects in customer meetings, and hold your own presenting strategy, trade\-offs, and results to BlueOptima's exec and C\-suite team. This isn't a seat where someone else makes the calls and you execute tickets — you're expected to have a point of view, in the room, internally and externally, and defend it.


Alongside the core mandate, you'll have room to shape how Code Insights grows through product\-led channels — using its shift\-left, developer\-first design (CLI, pre\-commit hooks, CI/CD scanning) as a wedge for organic adoption. This is a growth opportunity for the right person to build.

**What Impact Looks Like:**


We want whoever takes this role to know, concretely, what “doing this job well” means — outcomes we'll hold you to, not just activities:

* **Roadmap \& delivery** — Code Insights ships against a roadmap you've defined with key stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data and Revenue teams, and can defend, grounded in AppSec domain reality (SAST/SCA, secrets detection, OWASP alignment), not just inbound requests.
* **Customer\-facing conversion** — You're a credible voice in front of CISOs, SecOps leads, and security architects; customer pilots you own convert to paid, renewed, and expanded accounts.
* **Retention \& commercial outcome** — Success is tied directly to retention goals, so you're accountable for customers staying and growing, alongside deals closing.
* **Organic growth** — if you lean into the PLG opportunity, you'll have room to build and own a self\-serve growth motion — upside on top of the core mandate.

  

**Qualifications** **Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Own Direction and Roadmap (Core Mandate)**

* Set and defend the product roadmap for Code Insights — secrets detection, SAST, SCA/dependency risk — rooted in real AppSec domain expertise, not secondhand requirements.
* Partner with engineering to ship high\-quality, well\-scoped releases; own the trade\-off calls when scope, timeline, and security depth conflict.
* Report product health, risk, and roadmap progress directly to senior leadership — including exec/C\-suite settings — with the judgment to say what leadership needs to hear, not just what's easy to report.

jobs.title: Senior Channel Account Manager
jobs.description:
A Channel Account Manager (CAM) plays a pivotal role in managing relationships with channel partners (such as resellers, or value\-added partners) on behalf of a company. Here are typical roles and responsibilities of a Channel Account Manager:
  
  

**1\. \*Relationship Management\*:** Build and maintain strong relationships with channel partners to foster collaboration and ensure alignment with company goals.
  
  

**2\. \*Channel Development\*:** Identify opportunities for channel growth and development, including recruiting new partners and expanding existing partnerships into new markets or territories.
  
  

**3\. \*Training and Enablement\*:** Provide training and enablement resources to channel partners to ensure they have the necessary knowledge and skills to effectively sell and support the company's products or services.
  
  

**4\. \*Sales Support\*:** Collaborate with channel partners to develop and execute sales strategies, provide sales support, and address any issues or concerns that may arise during the sales process.
  
  

**5\. \*Forecasting and Planning\*:** Work closely with channel partners to forecast sales, set targets, and develop business plans to achieve mutual revenue objectives.
  
  

**6\. \*Marketing Support\*:** Coordinate with the marketing team to develop and implement channel\-specific marketing programs and campaigns to generate demand and drive sales through channel partners.
  
  

**7\. \*Performance Monitoring\*:** Track and analyze key performance metrics (such as sales performance, market share, and partner satisfaction) to evaluate the effectiveness of channel programs and initiatives.
  
  

**8\. \*Product Knowledge\*:** Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products or services, as well as industry trends and competitive landscape, to effectively support channel partners and advise on sales strategies.
  
  

**9\. \*Compliance and Governance\*:** Ensure that channel partners adhere to company policies, procedures, and contractual agreements, and maintain compliance with relevant regulations and standards.
  
  

**10\. \*Revenue Generation\*:** Drive revenue growth through effective management of channel partners, strategic planning, and execution of sales initiatives.
  
  

**11\. \*Feedback and Communication\*:** Gather feedback from channel partners on market trends, customer needs, competitor activities, and product performance, and communicate this information internally to relevant stakeholders to inform decision\-making and product development efforts.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Team** 




 Platform is the technical gatekeeper for everything Pratilipi builds. Behind every product we ship sits a Platform team \- the engineering backbone that powers shared infrastructure, common capabilities, internal tooling, the foundational technologies and developer productivity across all our business units.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are hiring a Technical Product Manager for the Platform team. The role has direct visibility into leadership across engineering and product, a clearly scoped mandate with defined success measures, and a rare shot at shaping how a platform organization transitions from operational gatekeeper to innovation engine.
 



  





 Your job is to be the translation layer between the business and the platform. As business priorities shift \- a vertical scaling faster than expected, another changing trajectory \- you ensure platform investments shift with them, proactively rather than reactively. You will work alongside an engineering leadership team who own technical execution; you bring business context, prioritization rigor, and cross\-functional alignment.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* **Business → Platform translation \-** 
  Continuously track how business and product priorities are evolving across different business units, and translate them into a platform priority map. Establishing regular connects with product and business leads to gather their future roadmap, so the platform anticipates and plans for their needs instead of catching up to them.



  




* **Prioritization and focus \-** 
  The platform serves every team in the company, and every team has legitimate asks. Build and run an objective prioritization framework \- strategic impact, business leverage, engineering effort, opportunity cost \- so the team spends its constrained bandwidth on the highest\-leverage work and reactive interruptions trend toward zero.



  




* **Cost optimization \-** 
  Infrastructure cost decisions today are largely engineering\-driven. You will add the business and product lens: mapping platform spend against business value delivered, identifying high\-cost/low\-value capabilities, and ensuring every major platform investment carries a documented business rationale alongside the engineering one.



  




* **Future capability planning \-** 
  Identify the shared foundational capabilities \- AI infrastructure being a live example \- that multiple teams will need, so they get built once for the organization instead of independently and inconsistently by each team. Maintain a 12\-18 month capability horizon and drive adoption of what gets built.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within your first year: 
 


* Platform priorities visibly re\-align when business context shifts, without escalation;
* Reactive/ad\-hoc work drops to a small fraction of team capacity;
* Major investments carry documented business\-value rationale; and
* At least one shared capability you championed is adopted across multiple business units.
* Engineering leaders spend less time on prioritization trade\-offs and more time on execution.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 4\-6 years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent close to engineering \- developer\-facing products, infrastructure, internal platforms, or SaaS/API products.
* Strong technical fluency: you can read an architecture discussion, understand cost and scalability trade\-offs, and hold your own in reviews \- without needing to be the one writing code.
* Demonstrated prioritization judgment in a high\-ambiguity, resource\-constrained environment. You know how to say no with a framework, not a feeling.
* Ability to understand business strategy, product direction, and technology constraints into a coherent, defensible roadmap narrative.
* Strong written communication \- much of this role's leverage comes from documents: priority maps, investment rationales, capability horizons.
* Comfort operating as a partner to engineering leadership rather than the sole decision\-maker. Platform prioritization here is a shared responsibility, weighted toward engineering while the team's foundational backlog is being worked down.
* An engineer shifted to Product for the love of Business would be a plus.



  





**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a user\-facing feature PM role \- feature and experimentation decisions stay with product/business unit teams.
* Not a process\-building role. We deliberately chose this experience band because we want sharp judgment applied to specific coordination and prioritization problems, not new layers of framework and ceremony.
* Not a solo flyer. Engineering leadership drives technical execution and engineering excellence; you drive business context, prioritization, and alignment. The strength of this role is the Partnership.



  





**Security \& Data Handling** 




 All employees are expected to handle sensitive data responsibly in compliance with the DPDP Act, ISO\-27001:2022, and Pratilipi's internal security policies — ensuring data privacy, confidentiality, and NDA obligations at all times.

**About Kim.cc** 




 Kim.cc is an AI powered customer support platform built for e\-commerce. We offer a suite of customer support products that integrate with helpdesks like Gorgias, Zendesk, Zoho Desk, and RichPanel, as well as our own native helpdesk. We also integrate with other third party tools commonly used across e\-commerce, and we support multiple customer support channels. Our goal is to help e\-commerce brands automate and improve support at scale.
 



**The Role** 




 We're hiring a Product Manager to own our platform, which is made up of core systems, some AI driven and others programmatic. 
 



 Our customers are e\-commerce businesses running real operations, so this role means thinking in terms of their business problems, and designing platform solutions that hold up across different customer setups, scales, and workflows. 
 



 This is fundamentally a product management role. AI is a significant part of what the platform does, so familiarity with how AI systems work is important.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Own the platform end to end : discovery to delivery of features 
 



 Identify and scope problems, whether they come from customers, internal teams, or data, into clear, actionable product problems
 



 Perform product research, design and drive solutions from concept to launch, working closely with engineering, design, and QA
 



 Write clear, detailed product specs and align cross functional stakeholders around them
 



 Validate decisions with evidence. Define and track the success metrics of the product.
 



 Write specs for AI systems grounded in AI governance and reliability risks like hallucination
 



 Bring clear judgment on which parts of the platform should be AI driven versus deterministic, and turn it into a roadmap serving multiple customer businesses at once
 



 Ability to contribute the requirements of your platform into the overall product goals
 



 What We're Looking For
 



**Must Haves** 




 Strong product management skills: discovery, prioritization, spec writing, and execution
 



 Excellent ability to define problems clearly, even when they start out messy or ambiguous
 



 Ability to conduct product research and translate it into clear, actionable next steps
 



 Sharp problem solving, with the ability to think outside the box
 



 Solid understanding of product testing and experimentation methodologies 
 



 Good working knowledge of platform analytics, including what to measure and why
 



 Proven ability to lead or strongly influence a cross functional team of developers, designers and QA, without direct reporting lines
 



 Ability to prompt and iterate on AI behavior
 



 General understanding of how AI systems, AI Agents or workflows are built, enough to have a real conversation with engineering
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 Awareness of hallucination and other AI reliability challenges, and how product decisions can account for them
 



 Experience working on a product with multiple third party integrations
 



 Exposure to helpdesk ecosystems such as Gorgias, Zendesk, Zoho, RichPanel or Freshdesk
 



 Experience working with Shopify e\-commerce ecosystem
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 Genuinely passionate about product and about building things that work
 



 Academically strong, with a track record that reflects rigor and depth
 



 Grounded, with high drive, low ego and high ownership
 



 Strong work ethic. You follow through, and you don't need to be chased
 



 Good oral and written communication
 



 Good social skills and people management skills
 



  





 Please share your resume as well as your portfolio if this role interests you at Hireme@kim.cc

 Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast\-changing retail environment? jobs.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Senior Network Engineer designs, implements, and supports Zillow’s network infrastructure to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity for employees, customers, and platforms. This role applies seasoned technical expertise to resolve moderately complex network issues, collaborates with cross\-functional teams to deliver stable services, and contributes to continuous improvement of network performance, monitoring, and automation.
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.


**About the role**
------------------

**Role Summary**
----------------

We are recruiting a top\-performing Senior Network Engineer to serve as the technical owner for Zillow’s on\-prem network and employee access infrastructure. This role owns physical and logical on\-prem network architecture, corporate LAN/WAN and Wi\-Fi, the current Cisco SSL client VPN, and has a meaningful technical stake in the design and deployment of next\-generation Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architectures.


The engineer will work in close partnership with engineers across a range of experience levels as part of a team that collectively owns corporate infrastructure outcomes. This role provides technical leadership through hands\-on engineering, collaboration, and influence—such as participating in design reviews, pairing on complex work, and leading incident response—while creating intentional opportunities to mentor and uplift more junior engineers. This mentorship is delivered through day\-to\-day engineering practices and shared problem\-solving, not people management.
 

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant autonomy, influence, and accountability, but no people management.


This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
**Who you are**
---------------

**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Own the architecture, standards, and lifecycle of on\-prem network infrastructure across Zillow offices
* Design, operate, and evolve LAN, WAN, and Wi\-Fi networks
* Lead equipment refreshes, obsolescence management, and vendor strategy
* Design networking for new office builds, expansions, and relocations
* Own Wi\-Fi architecture, performance, and user experience
* Own the Cisco SSL client VPN platform, including reliability, security, and user experience
* Ensure secure and dependable employee remote access
* Partner with endpoint, identity, and security teams on the design and rollout of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
* Help guide architectural decisions during the transition from VPN\-centric access to Zero Trust models
* Serve as senior escalation for complex incidents and outages
* Develop and maintain documentation, standards, diagrams, and runbooks
* Mentor and uplift junior engineers through technical leadership and collaboration
* Make pragmatic, cost\-conscious decisions that balance reliability, security, and sustainability.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.


As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.


Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

jobs.description:
**About WeRize**
 Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building Indias largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle\-class customers who live in 5000\+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd). This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket\-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property, health and life insurance and investment products.
   

  

 WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesnt work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance), a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000\+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.
   

  

 Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on\-the\-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesnt work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on\-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000\+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet\-on\-street team of its own.
   

  

**Location :** 
 Shilpitha Tech Park, Bellandur, Bangalore.
   

  

**Experience :** 
 4 \- 8 years

 Full\-time, On\-site

This role involves translating business needs into clear product requirements, working closely with engineering, operations, design, and stakeholders, and ensuring timely delivery of high\-impact product solutions. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of product development, user journeys, and business workflows, with the ability to balance strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
**All About Kantata**
 Kantata provides the Kantata Cloud for Professional Services™, which offers businesses clarity, control, and confidence to optimize resource planning and elevate operational performance. Our software is purpose\-built to help over 2,500 professional services organizations across more than 100 countries focus on their most important asset: their people. By leveraging Kantata, professionals gain access to the information and tools they need to win more business, ensure the right people are always available at the right time, and delight clients with exceptional project delivery and outcomes. Kantata is well\-capitalized, continuously hiring, and rapidly growing our loyal and diversified customer base. We are recognized as an employee\-rated Best Place to Work, providing a dynamic work environment with a team that is passionate about what they do.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 As an Product Manager at Kantata, you will be pivotal in driving the delivery of high\-quality, impactful product features. In this role, you will primarily act as a Product Owner, taking ownership of product execution and delivery, working closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-impact features and improvements. This role requires a proactive approach to product management, thriving in a fast\-paced environment, with a strong focus on delivering customer and business value.
   

  

 Primary Responsibilities:
   

  

* Act as the Product Owner for an agile development team, managing and prioritizing the product backlog.
* Write clear, concise, and actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and specifications for development teams.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, design, QA, and go\-to\-market teams to align on scope, execution, release timelines, and to drive adoption.
* Continuously refine and prioritize the backlog to ensure that the most valuable features are delivered first.
* Participate in and lead agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Gather and analyze customer feedback and data insights to drive iteration and optimization of product experiences.
* Work closely with Senior Product Managers on roadmap planning, and product strategy, and identifying gaps and opportunities in our products and processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, tracking, and communication of product changes across the organization.
* Monitor product performance and assist in defining KPIs and success metrics for product features.
* Bring a problem\-solving mindset—testing new ideas, iterating on solutions, and pushing for continuous improvement.


 What You Bring To The Role
   

  

 2\+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, or related roles in a tech\-driven environment.
   

  

* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and hands\-on experience working with development teams.
* Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and managing product backlogs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and a customer\-first mindset.
* Familiarity with product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., Business, Engineering, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.


 Preferred qualifications
   

  

* Experience working in a B2B or SaaS environment.
* Basic understanding of UX/UI principles or experience working closely with design teams.


 Additional Information
   

  

 This role is a remote role. We expect there will be times when meeting for an in person event will be necessary for your role.
   

  

 Call To Action
   

  

 Are you ready to lead the way in product management? Do you want to make a significant impact in a top\-rated workplace? Join us at Kantata, where your work directly contributes to our growth and innovation. Apply now to become part of a team that is passionate about making a difference!

### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

* Hands\-on configuration experience on SFDC Platform

The candidate will own the maintenance of business reviews, enhancement and standardisation of business reporting and analytical frameworks that enable operational decision\-making. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable reporting and automation solutions. The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining recurring reports and dashboards, supporting deep\-dive analyses, and providing ad hoc data support to Operations stakeholders. They should possess a strong understanding of business requirements, demonstrate the ability to quickly identify the root cause of reporting, BI, and data\-related issues, and recommend practical, scalable solutions.

**Role Summary**
 This role will act as the business owner for data migration from Microsoft Dynamics Navision to SAP S/4HANA across multiple European entities. The Business Analyst will ensure that data is accurate, complete, and aligned to business requirements, working closely with functional teams and local stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to migration responsibilities, this role will support process improvement initiatives, leveraging data insights and emerging AI capabilities to enhance efficiency, data quality, and decision\-making across the AMETEK International EMEA organisation.

* Own the end\-to\-end business validation of data migration from Navision to SAP S/4 across multiple countries
